premise: Ladybug thinks only Butterfly can fly, until she lifts her red back and finds her own wings folded underneath.
inspiration: The Ugly Duckling (Andersen), turned: no long winter of waiting, just a friend's question, and what she wished for was hers all along.
lesson: Sometimes what you wish for is already yours; you only have to look.
learning: A ladybug's thin flying wings fold away under her red spotted wing cases

en-US.title: Ladybug Finds Her Wings
en-US.text: {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:float loop 0.4} Butterfly flew over the meadow, up and down, light as a petal. {ladybug:enter} Ladybug {ladybug:pulse} watched from a leaf. {ladybug:face sad} [sad] I wish I could fly, she sighed. But my back is just round and red and spotty. {caterpillar:enter} Caterpillar {caterpillar:wobble} looked up from her lunch. [curious] Are you sure? she said. Have you ever looked underneath? Ladybug had never looked underneath. [slowly] So she tried. {ladybug:live} She lifted her red, spotty back, and there, folded up, were two thin, shiny wings! She spread them, {sfx:flutter} flutter, flutter, folded them away… and took a little bow. {caterpillar:face surprised} {ladybug:face happy} [gasps] Wings! cried Caterpillar. {caterpillar:sparkle} {caterpillar:face happy} [happily] And Ladybug flew {ladybug:float} all the way to the big {flower:enter} flower {flower:pulse} and back, just to be sure.

es-ES.title: Mariquita encuentra sus alas
es-ES.text: {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:float loop 0.4} Mariposa volaba sobre el prado, arriba y abajo, ligera como un pétalo. {ladybug:enter} Mariquita {ladybug:pulse} la miraba desde una hoja. {ladybug:face sad} [sad] Ojalá yo pudiera volar, suspiró. Pero mi espalda solo es redonda, roja y con lunares. {caterpillar:enter} Oruga {caterpillar:wobble} levantó la vista de su comida. [curious] ¿Seguro?, le dijo. ¿Has mirado alguna vez por debajo? Mariquita nunca había mirado por debajo. [slowly] Así que lo intentó. {ladybug:live} Levantó su espalda roja con lunares y allí, bien dobladitas, ¡había dos alas finas y brillantes! Las abrió, {sfx:flutter} fru, fru, las volvió a guardar… e hizo una pequeña reverencia. {caterpillar:face surprised} {ladybug:face happy} [gasps] ¡Alas!, gritó Oruga. {caterpillar:sparkle} {caterpillar:face happy} [happily] Y Mariquita voló {ladybug:float} hasta la {flower:enter} flor grande {flower:pulse} y volvió, solo para estar segura.

flutter.prompt: tiny insect wings fluttering quickly for a moment, a soft delicate whirr
